prompt:
Create one production sprite atlas for NPC073's guarded/skeptical eyes, using the supplied exact 2×2 repeated-original-upper-half grid as the only reference image.

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: native pixel-art portrait eye atlas
Primary request: Show a guarded, appraising expression distinct from neutral and angry.
Composition: Exactly four equal cells, each a complete 64×35 upper-half crop. Overall canvas ratio 64:35. Row-major: top-left OPEN; top-right HALF CLOSED; bottom-left FULLY CLOSED; bottom-right OPEN REPEAT. No labels, gutters, borders, panels, extra views, or zoomed features.
Expression: Asymmetric brows in every cell. The NPC's left eyebrow (viewer's right) lifts slightly; the other brow lowers slightly. Use a subtle skeptical asymmetry, not an angry V and not an exaggerated arch. Keep this same brow placement in open, half, closed, and repeated-open cells. Appraising eyes remain calm, with both pupils forward and unchanged in size, spacing, color, and location.
Subject and style: Preserve NPC073 face, eye spacing, hair, blue wand, original crop, muted skin palette, warm brown/amber compact iris clusters, and small soft source highlights. Native crisp pixel art with softened stepped shading.
Constraints: Change only the brows and eyelids within the eye feature area. Half and closed eyelids cover eyes naturally while preserving the guarded brow asymmetry. Keep all other face, wand, hair, forehead, nose and background registered and unchanged.
Avoid: Symmetric angry brows, a neutral expression, extreme raised brow, enlarged eyes, eye widening, pupil movement, bright whites, shiny highlights, thick dark outlines, blur, text, or changed head shape.
